import pytest
from store.cart import Cart, Item
from store.coupons import CouponError


def test_issue_remove_without_qty_clears_line():
    """With no qty, remove the whole line (current behavior)."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=1200, qty=3))
    cart.remove("MUG")
    assert len(cart.items) == 0  # 1 line - 1 line = 0 lines
    assert cart.subtotal_cents() == 0  # empty cart sums to 0


def test_issue_remove_partial_qty_decrements():
    """With a qty, decrease the line by that many units."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=1000, qty=3))
    cart.remove("MUG", qty=1)
    assert cart.items[0].qty == 2  # 3-1 = 2


def test_issue_remove_exact_qty_clears_line():
    """Removing the line when it reaches zero removes the line."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=800, qty=3))
    cart.remove("MUG", 3)
    assert len(cart.items) == 0  # 3-3 = 0 units so 0 lines


def test_issue_remove_more_than_available_raises():
    """Removing more units than are in the cart raises KeyError."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=800, qty=3))
    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
        cart.remove("MUG", 4)


def test_issue_remove_unknown_sku_raises():
    """A SKU that is not in the cart raises KeyError."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="PEN", name="Pen", price_cents=500, qty=1))
    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
        cart.remove("MUG")
    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
        cart.remove("MUG", qty=1)


def test_issue_remove_partial_updates_subtotal():
    """With a qty, decrease the line by that many units, updating subtotal."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=1000, qty=3))
    cart.add(Item(sku="PEN", name="Pen", price_cents=200, qty=2))
    cart.remove("MUG", qty=1)
    assert cart.subtotal_cents() == 2400  # 1000*2 + 200*2 = 2000+400 = 2400


def test_contract_subtotal_sums_lines():
    """Subtotal is the sum of price_cents * qty over every line."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=1000, qty=2))
    cart.add(Item(sku="B", name="B", price_cents=250, qty=4))
    assert cart.subtotal_cents() == 3000  # 1000*2 + 250*4 = 2000+1000 = 3000


def test_contract_add_same_sku_increases_qty():
    """Adding a SKU that is already in the cart increases that line's qty."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=1200, qty=1))
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=1200, qty=1))
    assert len(cart.items) == 1  # same SKU stays on 1 line
    assert cart.items[0].qty == 2  # 1+1 = 2


def test_contract_second_coupon_raises():
    """At most one coupon may be applied to a cart."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=5000, qty=1))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    with pytest.raises(CouponError):
        cart.apply_coupon("HALFOFF")


def test_contract_percent_coupon_rounded_down():
    """A percent coupon takes that percent off the whole subtotal, rounded down."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=199, qty=1))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    assert cart.discount_cents() == 19  # floor(199*10/100) = floor(19.9) = 19


def test_contract_fixed_coupon_minimum_and_cap():
    """A fixed coupon needs minimum subtotal and never exceeds subtotal."""
    low = Cart()
    low.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=1500, qty=1))
    low.apply_coupon("FIVEOFF")
    assert low.discount_cents() == 0  # 1500 < 2000 minimum so 0
    tiny = Cart()
    tiny.add(Item(sku="B", name="B", price_cents=300, qty=1))
    tiny.apply_coupon("TENOFF")
    assert tiny.discount_cents() == 300  # min(1000, 300) = 300


def test_contract_shipping_threshold_and_empty():
    """Shipping is free at $50 or more, else $5.99, empty has no charge."""
    assert Cart().shipping_cents() == 0  # empty cart ships for 0
    low = Cart()
    low.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=4999, qty=1))
    assert low.shipping_cents() == 599  # 4999 < 5000 so 599
    high = Cart()
    high.add(Item(sku="B", name="B", price_cents=5000, qty=1))
    assert high.shipping_cents() == 0  # 5000 >= 5000 so 0


def test_contract_tax_half_up():
    """Tax is 8% of the discounted subtotal, rounded half up, shipping not taxed."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=199, qty=1))
    assert cart.tax_cents() == 16  # 199*8/100 = 1592/100 = 15.92 -> 16


def test_contract_total_sums_and_never_negative():
    """Total is discounted subtotal plus shipping plus tax, never negative."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="A", name="A", price_cents=1000, qty=1))
    assert cart.total_cents() == 1679  # (1000-0)+599+80 = 1679 where 1000*8/100=80
    tiny = Cart()
    tiny.add(Item(sku="B", name="B", price_cents=300, qty=1))
    tiny.apply_coupon("TENOFF")
    assert tiny.total_cents() == 599  # (300-300)+599+0 = 599, never negative
